LESSONS WORTH CARRYING. Each one is also recorded where it binds, not only here.
1. GitHub ruleset gating: newest-per-context is not sufficient. An older queued row of a required context blocks a push (GH013). The CLAUDE.md profile predicate now includes the pending-row check (QCLI-364). The opum-fleet promotion reference and opum-agent promote.mjs were told; that is OPAG-374.
2. The opum-workflow trunk-write hook evaluates HEAD before a compound command runs, so `git checkout -b X && ... git commit` in ONE Bash call is refused on dev. Branch in a separate call.
3. `gh api --jq` takes no --argjson; pipe into jq instead.
4. lore 0.9.0 introduced an arc document type, so its schema export adds arc.schema.json and widens story.schema.json.
